page.layout: One printed page, main text in a single column; a narrow strip of text at the far left edge is the margin of the facing page (a fragment of the left neighbour, treated as a note on the left side).

main_text.head: ALIA TECHNOMETRIÆ Delineatio, per Quæstiones & Responsiones ad faciliorem captum instituta ac propofita.
main_text.p: 1. Quo apparatu dibes esse instructus, ut in Artibus peritus evadas?
Riplici apparatu; nempe ipsarum artium Præcognitione, Cognitione, & Recognitione.
2. Quid tibi generaliter præcognoscendum est ad Artes facilius discendas & adipiscendas?
Omnium & singularium artium in genere Naturam & Usum.
Ars est idea συνπαξίας regulis catholicis methodicè delineata.
6. Quid illa Artis definitio in genere in se comprehendit?
Quatuor communia requisita proponit, quæ ad quamlibet artem constituendam sunt necessaria. Ejusmodi est, Genus, Differentia, Materia generis, & ejusdem Forma.
7. Quid est commune Genus omnium artium? Est idea.

page.notes: The Greek word in question 5 (συνπαξίας, probably συνταξίας) is printed as shown and is uncertain. The left-margin fragment is largely illegible and is not transcribed. The catchword "Hæc" at the foot right is a running word and is given as a foot note. Some words in the body are blurred (e.g. "apparatu", "Technometriam") and read as printed with doubt.
